_doc: World treks (generated by tools/trails/world_tail.py from OpenStreetMap, ODbL, and the Copernicus DEM; never edit by hand). geo.enc: encoded polyline of lat, lon, metres.

trails.name: Mt. Kinabalu Climbathon Summit Race
trails.why: A waymarked path of 36 km, +3,379 m, up to 4,041 m, from near Kundasang.

trails.name: Trans CBR
trails.why: A waymarked path of 20 km, +1,518 m, up to 988 m, from near Kluang.

trails.name: RHB Hiking Circuit (Rajah - Hulu Bakau)
trails.why: Challenging hike through dense rainforest to circuit mountain peaks and back

trails.name: Makau Falls Hiking Trail
trails.why: Moderately challenging hike through dense rainforest to waterfalls.

trails.name: Gunung Nuang Hiking Trail via Janda Baik
trails.why: Trailhead starts with river crossing into Janda Baik farmland, then entering Lenteng Forest Reserve and ascending steep climb to peak.

trails.name: TBNSA: Main Facilities Scenic Loop
trails.why: Enjoy easy scenic hike along main features of the park: Paddy Fields, Fish Lake, model Kampung, Zingiberalace Garden, Spice Garden, swimming pool and Animal Garden with optional excursion to Air Kuning fishing reservoir.

trails.name: Medang Falls Hiking Trail
trails.why: Moderately challenging hike through dense rainforest to beautiful secluded Medang waterfalls with mini excursion to Lubuk Mecu

trails.name: Gunung Jasar - Cameron Valley Tea Trail
trails.why: Reputated as a magical experience. Hike through dense mossy forest, mountaintop viewpoint, electrical pylon & stream trekking, indigenous settlement, gorgeous tea plantation valley & picnic site to finally enjoy tea house refreshments.

trails.name: Bukit Kutu Hiking Trail (via Kampung Pertak)
trails.why: Moderately challenging hike through dense rainforest. There is an old colonial ruin at the peak of Kutu Hill.

trails.name: Bukit Kutu (via Old Colonial Route)
trails.why: Moderately challenging hike through dense rainforest. There is an old colonial ruin at the peak of Kutu Hill.

trails.name: Bukit Besar roundtrip
trails.why: To Bukit Besar peak via old dam / jungle trails, and back via farm tracks

trails.name: Lubuk Tupai
trails.why: Hiking trail through rainforest to Lubuk Tupai, a beautiful natural pool suitable for picnic.

trails.name: Bukit Repin Hiking Trail via Janda Baik
trails.why: Moderately challenging hike beginning from Orang Asli plantations into Lenteng Forest Reserve crossing 4 streams and the iconic big tree before arriving at the summit with views of Gunung Nuang.

trails.name: Mulu Mountain summit
trails.why: Mount Mulu is a sandstone and shale mountain. At 2376 m, it is the second highest mountain in the state of Sarawak, after Mount Murud.

trails.name: Mount Korbu
trails.why: Mount Korbu is a mountain in Hulu Kinta, Perak, Malaysia, about 25 km from Ipoh. It is the highest peak in the state of Perak, locatsd on the Titiwangsa Mountains, the southernmost section of the Tenasserim Hills.

trails.name: Mount Yong Belar
trails.why: Mount Yong Belar is a mountain on the border of the states Kelantan and Perak in the Titiwangsa Mountains of Malaysia.

trails.name: Mount Gayong
trails.why: Mount Gayong is the fourth highest mountain in the Malay Peninsula, at 2,173 metres. It can be reached in about an hour's trek from the peak of Mount Korbu, the second highest mountain in Peninsular Malaysia.

trails.name: Mount Chamah
trails.why: Gunung Chamah lies in the north-western corner of Kelantan and is the fifth highest mountain in Peninsular Malaysia.

trails.name: Mount Yong Yap
trails.why: Mount Yong Yap is a mountain located along the Perak and Kelantan state border in Peninsular Malaysia.

trails.name: list of mountains in Malaysia summit

points.name: list of mountains in Malaysia, 2,161 m

trails.why: The following is a sortable list of the mountains and hills of Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Batu Putih summit
trails.why: Located near Kampung Sungai Woh, Perak, Malaysia, this White Stone Mountain has an altitude of 2130 meters above sea level.

trails.name: Mount Benom
trails.why: Mount Benum or Mount Benom is a mountain in the state of Pahang in Malaysia. Its summit is 2,107 m above sea level.

trails.name: Gunung Gerah summit
trails.why: Mount Gerah, located in the area of Silk Forests, Perak/Kelantan, in the north of Peninsular Malaysia, has an altitude of 2,103 metres.

trails.name: Wray's Peak
trails.why: Mount Berembun or Wray Peak is a mountain located in Cameron Highlands, Pahang, Malaysia with an elevation of 1,841 metres.

trails.name: Mount Gedung
trails.why: Mount Gedung located in Pahang National Park, Pahang has an altitude of 2,066 meters.

trails.name: Gunung Bubu summit near Chemor
trails.why: Mount Bubu is located in Perak Darul Ridzuan, Malaysia. Its elevation is 1,657 meters. It is located in Kuala Kangsar, Perak.

trails.name: Gunung Chalil summit
trails.why: Mount Challi or Mount Pondok, also spelled as Peak Charlie is a mountain on the border of Perak Darul Ridzuan state with Pahang Darul Makmur, Malaysia and has an elevation of 1,923 metres.

trails.name: Noring West Mountain summit
trails.why: Anak Noring Mountain (1,888.8 metres) is one of the peaks located in Dabong district, in the Kuala Krai colony, Kelantan.

trails.name: Noring East summit
trails.why: Mount Noring East located in Titiwangsa Range, Kelantan, has an altitude of 1,861 meters.

trails.name: Mount Bintang
trails.why: Mount Bintang is a mountain on the border of the states Kedah and Perak in the Bintang Mountains, Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Tera summit
trails.why: Mount Tera or also called Mount Terra, is located in the Jelawang Forest located in Jajahan Kuala Krai, Kelantan, which is in the Kuala Krai South Region, Malaysia and has an altitude of 1,556 metres.

trails.name: Gunung Ayam summit near Kampung Kuala Balah
trails.why: Mount Ayam is located in the Jelawang Forest in Musang Cave, Kelantan, Malaysia. It has an altitude of 1,504 meters.

trails.name: Gunung Rabong summit
trails.why: Gunung Rabong is a mountain in Peninsular Malaysia that reaches a high altitude.

trails.name: Mount Lawit
trails.why: Mount Lawit is a mountain on the island of Borneo. It is 1767 metres tall and sits on the international border between Indonesia and Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Tapis summit
trails.why: Tapis Mountain located on the upper reaches of the Lembing River, Kuantan, Pahang Darul Makmur, Malaysia, has an elevation of 1,511 metres.

trails.name: Gunung Besar Hantu summit
trails.why: Hantu Great Mountain is a mountain located in Mukim Kenaboi, Jelebu, Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia, near the border with Pahang state, at an altitude of 1,462 meters.

trails.name: Mount Setong
trails.why: Mount Setong or Mount Stong is a mountain located in Dabong, southern Kuala Krai District, Kelantan, Malaysia.

trails.name: Mount Ulu Semangkok
trails.why: Mount Ulu Semangkok located in Kuala Kubu Baharu, Selangor has an altitude of 1,440 meters.

trails.name: Gunung Palas summit
trails.why: Ulu Bakar Mountain located in Pahang National Park, Pahang has an altitude of 1,391 meters.

trails.name: Gunung Saji summit
trails.why: Mount Saji is located in the Jelawang Forest located in Jajahan Kuala Krai, Kelantan, Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Panggang Paku summit
trails.why: The Paku Panggang Mountain located in the Cameron Pahang Highlands, Pahang has an altitude of 1,267 meters.

trails.name: Gunung Serudum summit
trails.why: Mount Serudum is a mountain located in Mukim Hulu Lepar, Kuantan District, Pahang, Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Rembau summit
trails.why: Mount Datuk, also known as Mount Rembau, is a mountain located between Batang Nyamor, Rembau and Kuala Johol, Kuala Pilah, Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia, at an elevation of 884 metres.

trails.name: Gunung Perak summit
trails.why: Mount Perak is a mountain in the state of Kedah Darul Aman, Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Chemendong summit
trails.why: Mount Chemendong is a mountain located in Kluang District, Johor, Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Angsi summit
trails.why: Mount Angsi is a mountain located between the border of Ulu Bendul, Kuala Pilah District and Senawang, Seremban District in Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Berantai summit
trails.why: Mount Berantai is a mountain located in Mukim Chenor in Maran District, Pahang, Malaysia.

trails.name: Mount Mat Chinchang
trails.why: Mat Chinchang Mountain located in Langkawi, Kedah has an altitude of 713 meters.

trails.name: Gunung Janing summit
trails.why: Mount Janing is 2150 feet above sea level and is located in the Endau-Rompin National Park area of Mersing District, Johor, Malaysia.

trails.name: Bukit Palong summit
trails.why: Palong Hill is a hill located in Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia. It is 645 meters high.

trails.name: Gunung Muntahak summit
trails.why: Mount Muntahak is located in the Highlands of Johor, Malaysia, at an altitude of 713 meters.

trails.name: Gunung Sumalayang summit
trails.why: Mount Sumalayang is a mountain located in the High City District, Johor, Malaysia.

trails.name: Gunung Janing Barat summit
trails.why: Mount Janing West has an elevation of 1870 feet. The mountain is quite unique in that it has a flat-topped peak; around the mountain there are walls with inclines of up to 90 degrees and heights ranging from 50 to 250 feet.

trails.name: Berkelah Falls
trails.why: Berkelah Falls is a cascade of waterfalls located in Pahang, Malaysia. It is about 31 to 35 km away from Kuantan City in the direction of Maran.

trails.name: Upeh Guling waterfall
trails.why: Unique volcanic rock formations where riverbed forms many natural circular "bathtubs"
